title: Sales Representative - Immediate Start
description:
Entry Level Sales Opportunity: Sales Associate - Portsmouth

Full-Time Immediate Start Availability

Looking for more than just another job

Whether you're starting your career or looking for a fresh challenge, our Portsmouth-based client offers full training, ongoing support and the opportunity to develop valuable sales and communication skills in a fast-paced, people-focused environment.

Please note: Full-Time Equivalent availability is required (5 full days per week between Monday and Saturday).

Our client is looking for enthusiastic individuals to join their team as Entry Level Sales Representatives, representing well-known brands through face-to-face event-based campaigns across Portsmouth and the surrounding areas.

If you enjoy meeting new people, working as part of a team and building confidence in a customer-facing role, this could be the opportunity for you.

What's needed to be successful
- A willingness to learn and develop new skills
- Strong English communication and interpersonal skills
- Confidence in face-to-face interactions
- A proactive mindset and positive attitude
- Full-Time availability (5 full days per week)

What you can expect

Alongside full product and client training from day one, successful applicants will benefit from ongoing coaching and mentoring within a supportive environment designed to encourage both personal and professional development.
- Monthly Sales Masterclasses with the wider South Coast organisation, offering networking and development opportunities.
- Quarterly national conferences attended by 300-600 people, featuring guest speakers and business development sessions.
- Mission 20 performance groups focused on individual growth, accountability and team success.
- National and international travel opportunities, including an upcoming R&R trip to Greece in September 2026.
- Performance-based incentives, office competitions and recognition opportunities throughout the year.
- Regular team socials, including bowling, BBQs, mini golf, team nights out and the annual Christmas Party at the Hilton Hotel.

Our client believes in recognising hard work and creating an environment where people can develop both personally and professionally. From the support available within the office to the opportunity to build valuable skills and experiences, they are committed to helping motivated individuals reach their potential. And as an added bonus, the office is also home to two friendly dachshunds!

Role Responsibilities
- Represent a range of brands associated with the client
- Engage confidently with customers in face-to-face sales environments
- Attend initial training with ongoing coaching and development opportunities
- Travel to different campaign locations and provide feedback on performance
- Maintain a confident, professional and positive approach when representing the client

This opportunity operates on a subcontracted basis, with uncapped commission and performance incentives. Full training, coaching and ongoing support are provided, making it suitable for individuals looking to build confidence and develop within a customer-facing role.

Applicants from all backgrounds are welcome. Previous experience in customer service, sales, retail, hospitality or other customer-facing roles may be beneficial, but no experience is required.

This role is not suitable for candidates still in education (school/College/University), or current international students. Due to availability, our client is seeking candidates that are available 5 full days per week, between Mon-Sat.

Please note, by applying to this advert you acknowledge our privacy policy applies and give consent for Blackwater Recruitment to share the data you provide with our client so that they may contact you regarding the role or any other role they deem you suitable for. For more information, please see our website before applying.

title: Customer Service Officer
description:
Job Title: Customer Contact Advisor Type: TemporaryLocation: Eastleigh / BracknellSalary: £15.27 - £19.84 an hourHours: Full Time, 37 hours BRC are working closely with a leading housing organisation to recruit a Customer Contact Advisor on a temporary basis. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong customer service experience who enjoys helping people and resolving a wide range of housing-related enquiries in a fast-paced contact centre environment. This role involves delivering an excellent front-line customer service by handling enquiries via telephone, face-to-face and digital channels. You will resolve a broad range of housing enquiries, provide advice and support to residents, and ensure customers receive a prompt, professional and high-quality service. Duties:
- Act as the first point of contact for customers via telephone, face-to-face and digital channels.
- Resolve a wide range of customer enquiries, aiming to achieve first-contact resolution wherever possible.
- Diagnose and raise responsive repair requests, arrange appointments and liaise with contractors.
- Provide advice and support regarding anti-social behaviour, tenancy queries and rent accounts.
- Book appointments for surveyors, housing officers, income officers and contractors.
- Record and update customer information accurately on internal systems.
- Follow up on complex enquiries to ensure they are resolved to a high standard.
- Carry out administration tasks relating to customer enquiries and case resolution.
- Keep up to date with policies, procedures and housing services to provide accurate advice.
- Identify customer vulnerabilities and ensure services are delivered appropriately.
- Contribute ideas to improve customer service and team performance.

Requirements:
- Previous experience in a contact centre, customer service or front-line service role.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Ability to remain calm and professional in challenging situations.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience using IT systems to accurately record customer information.
- Ability to work to targets and manage a busy workload.
- A proactive approach with the ability to take ownership of customer enquiries.
- Experience within social housing or a housing-related environment would be advantageous

For more information, please call Meg Smith on or . To apply, please submit your CV outlining your relevant experience and qualifications. We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. At BRC Recruitment, we try to respond to all applications; however, due to the high volume of applications, this is not always possible. If you have not heard from us within 72 hours, please assume that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
Strategic Customer Success Manager

Salary: £60,000-£70,000 + 10-20% performance-related bonus

Location: Remote, UK

MFK Recruitment is proud to be working with a well-established global software company to recruit a Strategic Customer Success Manager.

Our client provides an AI-powered, code-free testing platform that helps organisations test critical ERP and business applications, reduce risk and deliver business change more effectively.

We know this business extremely well. Over the past six years, MFK Recruitment has placed 16 people with the company, and 10 are still working there today.

The Strategic Customer Success Manager will take ownership of a portfolio of strategic, growth and high-potential customers. You will build strong relationships with senior, operational and technical stakeholders, ensuring customers achieve measurable value from their investment.

This is a commercially focused Customer Success position covering customer adoption, retention, renewals and account growth.

Key responsibilities
- Build trusted relationships with executive, operational and technical stakeholders
- Understand customers' business objectives, priorities and measures of success
- Create and deliver strategic customer success plans
- Lead executive business reviews focused on outcomes, adoption, ROI and future priorities
- Drive product adoption and identify barriers affecting customer engagement
- Develop relationships across multiple areas of each customer organisation
- Monitor customer health, engagement, adoption and value realisation
- Identify potential risks and create mitigation plans well ahead of renewals
- Maintain accurate renewal forecasts
- Identify and develop expansion opportunities within existing accounts
- Build compelling commercial proposals linked to customer priorities
- Work closely with Sales, Product, Support and Professional Services
- Represent the voice of the customer across the business
- Identify opportunities for customer references, case studies and advocacy

What we are looking for
- At least five years' experience in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management or Enterprise Account Management
- Experience managing complex enterprise or global customer relationships
- A strong record of customer retention and successful renewals
- Experience identifying and developing recurring revenue growth opportunities
- Strong commercial, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills
- Experience within a B2 B SaaS, software or subscription-based company
- Confidence communicating with senior executives, operational leaders and technical stakeholders
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to use customer data effectively
- Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills
- The ability to manage multiple priorities while working remotely

Experience within enterprise software, ERP, software testing or other business-critical applications would be advantageous.

Package and working arrangements
- £60,000-£70,000 basic salary
- 10-20% performance-related bonus, depending on experience
- Remote working
- Private healthcare
- Pension
- Life assurance
- 25 days' annual leave
- Your birthday off

The successful candidate will need reasonable access to the South of England for quarterly company and team meetings. Some flexibility will also be required when supporting customers across international time zones.
